How do I start a return or an exchange?
To start a return, please follow these steps:
Create your return online
Visit https://montirex.loopreturns.com/#/ and enter your order number along with your postcode or the email address used to place the order. Click 'Get Started' and select the item(s) you wish to return, providing the reason for the return. Follow the instructions provided. Once your return is logged, you will receive an email with further instructions and a free returns barcode label.
Pack your return
Place the items you wish to return in secure packaging. You can reuse the polybag your items arrived in. Ensure the package is securely sealed.
Ship your return
UK Customers: Take the QR code provided to a nearby drop-off location to scan and return the parcel.
International Customers: Print the PDF label provided and attach it firmly to the parcel, ensuring it covers any pre-existing labels. Then, take the parcel to your local drop-off location.
Return confirmation and refund
Once your parcel is received and inspected by our quality assurance team, you will be notified of the progress. Refunds are processed as soon as the inspection is complete, and the entire process can take up to 14 days.
